integrity: All listed files are complete text artifacts; the claim depends on the stated classical prime-divisor theorem and homogeneous K_m-free extension property. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for pointwise-named complete multipartite bases with at most m-2 nonempty parts in K_m-free homogeneous graphs, m>=5, and only complete injective one-/two-types. The inverse is finite/effective but not claimed efficient. Infinite proof cites Bang--Zsigmondy; finite computation is diagnostic; historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Two numerical types recover every multipartite shore at the critical Henson clique rank
